pretreatments.description: Mechanical degradation by crushing the pepper plant (Capsicum sp.) and eggplant (Solanum melongena) residues to facilitate homogenization.
Hydrothermal pretreatment carried out in closed bottles in an autoclave at 120 °C and 2 atm for times of 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 60 and 70 min.
